name: limn
description: Realtime collaborative whiteboard with OpenCV stroke beautification and Gemini-powered diagram synthesis.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter ./packages/... build && pnpm --filter @limn/realtime build && pnpm --filter @limn/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n web,rt,cv -c cyan,magenta,green "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:realtime" "pnpm dev:vision"
